name: NumberField
summary: A number to type, step, drag or calculate, from a form field to a dense inspector row. Arrows step it (Shift ×10, Alt ×0.1), Page Up and Page Down by ten steps, Home and End to the limits; the − and + buttons repeat while held; dragging the glyph, icon or visible label scrubs it with the pointer hidden and locked (Shift ×10, Alt ×0.1, Escape puts it back). Typing takes units ("24px", or another of `units` to switch), arithmetic ("12*2") and changes ("+4"). Shows "Mixed" for a selection whose values differ and "Auto" where the value can be worked out; offers common values (`presets`) in a list at the box's end. Not for numbers nobody adjusts (a postcode, a card number: TextField with `inputMode="numeric"`) or a value whose position in a range matters more than its digits (Slider).
a11y: A native `input` with `role="spinbutton"`, `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax` and `aria-valuetext` (with the unit, or "Mixed"); named by `label` even when it's hidden. The steppers and the scrub handle repeat what the keys do, so they're left out of the tab order. The wheel changes the value only while the field has focus; otherwise it scrolls the page. Arrow keys save after a pause, never on every press.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the value: "Width", "Opacity". Shown above the box unless `hideLabel`; always the accessible name.

props.name: value
props.description: The stored number, `'mixed'` when several selected items hold different values, or `'auto'` (with `auto`).

props.name: onCommit
props.description: Stores a new number: after typing (Enter or leaving), a scrub, a stepper press, or a pause in arrow keys. Return a promise for a save; reject it when it fails.

props.name: step
props.description: One arrow press, one stepper press, one pixel of scrubbing. Shift: ×10, Alt: ×0.1.

props.name: precision
props.description: Decimal places kept; defaults to one more than the step's (for Alt ×0.1). Trailing zeros are not shown.

props.name: unit
props.description: Shown after the number and accepted when typed: "px", "%", "°".

props.name: glyph
props.description: A short mark before the number, e.g. "W", "H", "X", "Y". Drag it to change the value.

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon before the number (rotation, corner radius). Drag it to change the value.

props.name: steppers
props.description: Adds − and + buttons; hold one to repeat.

props.name: size
props.description: The Button size scale; inspector rows use `xs` or `s`.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Hides the visible label where the glyph or icon and the row's heading already say what it is (an inspector). It still names the field.

props.name: error
props.description: What is wrong and how to fix it.

props.name: auto
props.description: The value can be Auto (line height, auto layout spacing): the box shows "Auto"; typing "auto" or emptying the box calls `onAuto`. `computed` is the number Auto works out to, where arrows and dragging start. `label` names the no-number value where Auto isn't the word, e.g. "None" for a minimum width that isn't set.

props.name: variable
props.description: The value comes from a variable ("spacing/md"): the box shows its name, the number can't be typed or dragged, and Detach (`onDetach`) turns it back into a plain number.

props.name: units
props.description: Units the person can switch to by typing one ("2px" in a % field), as letter spacing and line height do. The box shows `unit`; a typed other unit calls `onUnitChange` first, then `onCommit`.

props.name: presets
props.description: Common values in a list at the box's end (font sizes, export scales); any other number can still be typed.
